fullText.simplified:
第四章、我的楚国

    战国末期的七个主要国家，我已经介绍了六个了，现在介绍最后一个国家——楚国。
    南边的楚国，就是我的国家，是七国中面积最大的国家。楚国和秦国的关系比较复杂，有时候友好，有时候为了争抢土地，又会发生战争。楚国有一块很重要的土地，叫商屋，面积有六百多里，就是在战争中被秦国抢去的，楚国的王和百姓都想把它要回来。
    这就是当时的情况。七国的王都很清楚：只有自己变强大，才能不被人消灭，而自己变强大了，就能消灭别人。
    为了保护自己和消灭别人，七国之间会结盟。
    比如，四个小国为了不被西边的秦国消灭，会去找东边的齐国结盟。当五个国家结合在一起时，秦国就不敢轻易进攻其中任何一个国家了。又比如，楚国为了进攻秦国，会和齐国结盟，而齐国为了进攻楚国，也会和秦国结盟。
    好像有点儿复杂，不过没关系，你只需要知道一点就好了：七国之间的关系是经常变化的，今天是朋友，明天可能是敌人。
    好了，介绍完“七国”，下面我继续说故事。
    我来到兰台没多久，楚怀王就给了我一个工作。这个工作比较轻松，整理诗歌和教王室子弟文化知识，我做得很好。
    随着交流越来越多，楚怀王对我的信任也越来越深。他和我有一样的理想，对管理国家也有相同的想法。
    首先，我们都认为楚国需要一场大的改革。贵族的权势太大，军队的管理太差，百姓的生活太苦，优秀但穷的人得不到做官的机会……这些都是楚国需要解决的问题。只有解决掉这些问题，楚国才能变强大。
    其次，在与秦国的关系上，楚国很多官员和贵族，特别是楚怀王的小儿子子兰，都认为楚国应该与秦国结盟，保持友好的关系。但我认为秦国不会真的与楚国保持友好的关系，楚国应该与齐国结盟。楚怀王同意我的想法，他派我去齐国，与齐王讨论结盟的事情。一切都很顺利，楚国与齐国结盟了。
fullText.traditional:
第四章、我的楚國

    戰國末期的七個主要國家，我已經介紹了六個了，現在介紹最後一個國家——楚國。
    南邊的楚國，就是我的國家，是七國中面積最大的國家。楚國和秦國的關係比較複雜，有時候友好，有時候為了爭搶土地，又會發生戰爭。楚國有一塊很重要的土地，叫商屋，面積有六百多里，就是在戰爭中被秦國搶去的，楚國的王和百姓都想把它要回來。
    這就是當時的情況。七國的王都很清楚：只有自己變強大，才能不被人消滅，而自己變強大了，就能消滅別人。
    為了保護自己和消滅別人，七國之間會結盟。
    比如，四個小國為了不被西邊的秦國消滅，會去找東邊的齊國結盟。當五個國家結合在一起時，秦國就不敢輕易進攻其中任何一個國家了。又比如，楚國為了進攻秦國，會和齊國結盟，而齊國為了進攻楚國，也會和秦國結盟。
    好像有點兒複雜，不過沒關係，你只需要知道一點就好了：七國之間的關係是經常變化的，今天是朋友，明天可能是敵人。
    好了，介紹完“七國”，下面我繼續說故事。
    我來到蘭臺沒多久，楚懷王就給了我一個工作。這個工作比較輕鬆，整理詩歌和教王室子弟文化知識，我做得很好。
    隨著交流越來越多，楚懷王對我的信任也越來越深。他和我有一樣的理想，對管理國家也有相同的想法。
    首先，我們都認為楚國需要一場大的改革。貴族的權勢太大，軍隊的管理太差，百姓的生活太苦，優秀但窮的人得不到做官的機會……這些都是楚國需要解決的問題。只有解決掉這些問題，楚國才能變強大。
    其次，在與秦國的關係上，楚國很多官員和貴族，特別是楚懷王的小兒子子蘭，都認為楚國應該與秦國結盟，保持友好的關係。但我認為秦國不會真的與楚國保持友好的關係，楚國應該與齊國結盟。楚懷王同意我的想法，他派我去齊國，與齊王討論結盟的事情。一切都很順利，楚國與齊國結盟了。

sentences.simplified: 战国末期的七个主要国家，我已经介绍了六个了，
sentences.traditional: 戰國末期的七個主要國家，我已經介紹了六個了，
sentences.pinyin: zhàn guó mò qī de qī ge zhǔ yào guó jiā wǒ yǐ jīng jiè shào le liù ge le
sentences.english: I have already introduced six of the seven major states in the late Warring States period.

sentences.simplified: 现在介绍最后一个国家——楚国。
sentences.traditional: 現在介紹最後一個國家——楚國。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài jiè shào zuì hòu yí ge guó jiā chǔ guó
sentences.english: Now I will introduce the last one—the state of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 南边的楚国，就是我的国家，是七国中面积最大的国家。
sentences.traditional: 南邊的楚國，就是我的國家，是七國中面積最大的國家。
sentences.pinyin: nán bian de chǔ guó jiù shì wǒ de guó jiā shì qī guó zhōng miàn jī zuì dà de guó jiā
sentences.english: The southern state of Chu, my homeland, was the largest of the Seven Warring States in territory.

sentences.simplified: 楚国和秦国的关系比较复杂，
sentences.traditional: 楚國和秦國的關係比較複雜，
sentences.pinyin: chǔ guó hé qín guó de guān xi bǐ jiào fù zá
sentences.english: The relationship between the state of Chu and the state of Qin was quite complex.

sentences.simplified: 有时候友好，有时候为了争抢土地，又会发生战争。
sentences.traditional: 有時候友好，有時候為了爭搶土地，又會發生戰爭。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hou yǒu hǎo yǒu shí hou wèi le zhēng qiǎng tǔ dì yòu huì fā shēng zhàn zhēng
sentences.english: Sometimes they were friendly, and sometimes they went to war over territory.

sentences.simplified: 楚国有一块很重要的土地，叫商屋，面积有六百多里，
sentences.traditional: 楚國有一塊很重要的土地，叫商屋，面積有六百多里，
sentences.pinyin: chǔ guó yǒu yí kuài hěn zhòng yào de tǔ dì jiào shāng wū miàn jī yǒu liù bǎi duō lǐ
sentences.english: The state of Chu had a very important piece of land called Shangwu, covering more than six hundred li.

sentences.simplified: 就是在战争中被秦国抢去的，楚国的王和百姓都想把它要回来。
sentences.traditional: 就是在戰爭中被秦國搶去的，楚國的王和百姓都想把它要回來。
sentences.pinyin: jiù shì zài zhàn zhēng zhōng bèi qín guó qiǎng qù de chǔ guó de wáng hé bǎi xìng dōu xiǎng bǎ tā yào huí lai
sentences.english: It had been seized by Qin during a war, and both the king and the people of Chu wanted to win it back.

sentences.simplified: 这就是当时的情况。
sentences.traditional: 這就是當時的情況。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì dāng shí de qíng kuàng
sentences.english: This was the situation at the time.

sentences.simplified: 七国的王都很清楚：
sentences.traditional: 七國的王都很清楚：
sentences.pinyin: qī guó de wáng dōu hěn qīng chu
sentences.english: The rulers of the Seven Warring States all understood this:

sentences.simplified: 只有自己变强大，才能不被人消灭，而自己变强大了，就能消灭别人。
sentences.traditional: 只有自己變強大，才能不被人消滅，而自己變強大了，就能消滅別人。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu zì jǐ biàn qiáng dà cái néng bú bèi rén xiāo miè ér zì jǐ biàn qiáng dà le jiù néng xiāo miè bié rén
sentences.english: Only by becoming strong themselves could they avoid being conquered, and once they became strong, they could conquer others.

sentences.simplified: 为了保护自己和消灭别人，七国之间会结盟。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護自己和消滅別人，七國之間會結盟。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le bǎo hù zì jǐ hé xiāo miè bié rén qī guó zhī jiān huì jié méng
sentences.english: To protect themselves and conquer others, the Seven Warring States would form alliances.

sentences.simplified: 比如，四个小国为了不被西边的秦国消灭，会去找东边的齐国结盟。
sentences.traditional: 比如，四個小國為了不被西邊的秦國消滅，會去找東邊的齊國結盟。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú sì ge xiǎo guó wèi le bú bèi xī biān de qín guó xiāo miè huì qù zhǎo dōng bian de qí guó jié méng
sentences.english: For example, to avoid being conquered by Qin to the west, the four small states would seek an alliance with Qi to the east.

sentences.simplified: 当五个国家结合在一起时，秦国就不敢轻易进攻其中任何一个国家了。
sentences.traditional: 當五個國家結合在一起時，秦國就不敢輕易進攻其中任何一個國家了。
sentences.pinyin: dāng wǔ ge guó jiā jié hé zài yì qǐ shí qín guó jiù bù gǎn qīng yì jìn gōng qí zhōng rèn hé yí ge guó jiā le
sentences.english: When five states combined, Qin would not dare to attack any one of them lightly.

sentences.simplified: 又比如，楚国为了进攻秦国，会和齐国结盟，而齐国为了进攻楚国，也会和秦国结盟。
sentences.traditional: 又比如，楚國為了進攻秦國，會和齊國結盟，而齊國為了進攻楚國，也會和秦國結盟。
sentences.pinyin: yòu bǐ rú chǔ guó wèi le jìn gōng qín guó huì hé qí guó jié méng ér qí guó wèi le jìn gōng chǔ guó yě huì hé qín guó jié méng
sentences.english: Similarly, Chu would ally with Qi to attack Qin, and Qi would ally with Qin to attack Chu.

sentences.simplified: 好像有点儿复杂，不过没关系，你只需要知道一点就好了：
sentences.traditional: 好像有點兒複雜，不過沒關係，你只需要知道一點就好了：
sentences.pinyin: hǎo xiàng yǒu diǎn'r fù zá bú guò méi guān xi nǐ zhǐ xū yào zhī dào yì diǎn jiù hǎo le
sentences.english: It seems a bit complicated, but that’s okay. You only need to know one thing:

sentences.simplified: 七国之间的关系是经常变化的，
sentences.traditional: 七國之間的關係是經常變化的，
sentences.pinyin: qī guó zhī jiān de guān xi shì jīng cháng biàn huà de
sentences.english: The relationships between the Seven Warring States were constantly changing.

sentences.simplified: 今天是朋友，明天可能是敌人。
sentences.traditional: 今天是朋友，明天可能是敵人。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān shì péng you míng tiān kě néng shì dí rén
sentences.english: Today, they might be friends, but tomorrow, they could be enemies.

sentences.simplified: 好了，介绍完“七国”，下面我继续说故事。
sentences.traditional: 好了，介紹完“七國”，下面我繼續說故事。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo le jiè shào wán qī guó xià miàn wǒ jì xù shuō gù shi
sentences.english: All right, having introduced the “Seven Warring States”, I will continue with the story.

sentences.simplified: 我来到兰台没多久，楚怀王就给了我一个工作。
sentences.traditional: 我來到蘭臺沒多久，楚懷王就給了我一個工作。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ lái dào lán tái méi duō jiǔ chǔ huái wáng jiù gěi le wǒ yí ge gōng zuò
sentences.english: Not long after I arrived at the Orchid Terrace, King Huai of Chu gave me a job.

sentences.simplified: 这个工作比较轻松，整理诗歌和教王室子弟文化知识，我做得很好。
sentences.traditional: 這個工作比較輕鬆，整理詩歌和教王室子弟文化知識，我做得很好。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge gōng zuò bǐ jiào qīng sōng zhěng lǐ shī gē hé jiāo wáng shì zǐ dì wén huà zhī shi wǒ zuò de hěn hǎo
sentences.english: This job was relatively easy—editing poetry and teaching cultural knowledge to the children of the royal family—and I did it well.

sentences.simplified: 随着交流越来越多，楚怀王对我的信任也越来越深。
sentences.traditional: 隨著交流越來越多，楚懷王對我的信任也越來越深。
sentences.pinyin: suí zhe jiāo liú yuè lái yuè duō chǔ huái wáng duì wǒ de xìn rèn yě yuè lái yuè shēn
sentences.english: As our interactions increased, King Huai of Chu’s trust in me also deepened.

sentences.simplified: 他和我有一样的理想，对管理国家也有相同的想法。
sentences.traditional: 他和我有一樣的理想，對管理國家也有相同的想法。
sentences.pinyin: tā hé wǒ yǒu yí yàng de lǐ xiǎng duì guǎn lǐ guó jiā yě yǒu xiāng tóng de xiǎng fǎ
sentences.english: He and I shared the same ideals and had similar views on governing the state.

sentences.simplified: 首先，我们都认为楚国需要一场大的改革。
sentences.traditional: 首先，我們都認為楚國需要一場大的改革。
sentences.pinyin: shǒu xiān wǒ men dōu rèn wéi chǔ guó xū yào yì cháng dà de gǎi gé
sentences.english: First, we both believed that the state of Chu needed a major reform.

sentences.simplified: 贵族的权势太大，军队的管理太差，百姓的生活太苦，
sentences.traditional: 貴族的權勢太大，軍隊的管理太差，百姓的生活太苦，
sentences.pinyin: guì zú de quán shì tài dà jūn duì de guǎn lǐ tài chà bǎi xìng de shēng huó tài kǔ
sentences.english: The nobility had too much power, the army was poorly managed, the people’s lives were too hard, ..

sentences.simplified: 优秀但穷的人得不到做官的机会……这些都是楚国需要解决的问题。
sentences.traditional: 優秀但窮的人得不到做官的機會……這些都是楚國需要解決的問題。
sentences.pinyin: yōu xiù dàn qióng de rén dé bú dào zuò guān de jī huì zhè xiē dōu shì chǔ guó xū yào jiě jué de wèn tí
sentences.english: .. and talented but poor people had no opportunity to become officials … these were all issues that the state of Chu needed to address.

sentences.simplified: 只有解决掉这些问题，楚国才能变强大。
sentences.traditional: 只有解決掉這些問題，楚國才能變強大。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu jiě jué diào zhè xiē wèn tí chǔ guó cái néng biàn qiáng dà
sentences.english: Only by solving these problems could the state of Chu become strong.

sentences.simplified: 其次，在与秦国的关系上，楚国很多官员和贵族，特别是楚怀王的小儿子子兰，
sentences.traditional: 其次，在與秦國的關係上，楚國很多官員和貴族，特別是楚懷王的小兒子子蘭，
sentences.pinyin: qí cì zài yǔ qín guó de guān xi shang chǔ guó hěn duō guān yuán hé guì zú tè bié shì chǔ huái wáng de xiǎo ér zi zǐ lán
sentences.english: Secondly, regarding relations with Qin, many officials and nobles of Chu, especially King Huai of Chu’s youngest son Zilan, ..

sentences.simplified: 都认为楚国应该与秦国结盟，保持友好的关系。
sentences.traditional: 都認為楚國應該與秦國結盟，保持友好的關係。
sentences.pinyin: dōu rèn wéi chǔ guó yīng gāi yǔ qín guó jié méng bǎo chí yǒu hǎo de guān xi
sentences.english: .. believed that Chu should ally with Qin and maintain a friendly relationship.

sentences.simplified: 但我认为秦国不会真的与楚国保持友好的关系，楚国应该与齐国结盟。
sentences.traditional: 但我認為秦國不會真的與楚國保持友好的關係，楚國應該與齊國結盟。
sentences.pinyin: dàn wǒ rèn wéi qín guó bú huì zhēn de yǔ chǔ guó bǎo chí yǒu hǎo de guān xi chǔ guó yīng gāi yǔ qí guó jié méng
sentences.english: However, I believed that Qin would not truly maintain a friendly relationship with Chu. Instead, Chu should ally with Qi.

sentences.simplified: 楚怀王同意我的想法，他派我去齐国，与齐王讨论结盟的事情。
sentences.traditional: 楚懷王同意我的想法，他派我去齊國，與齊王討論結盟的事情。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ huái wáng tóng yì wǒ de xiǎng fǎ tā pài wǒ qù qí guó yǔ qí wáng tǎo lùn jié méng de shì qing
sentences.english: King Huai of Chu agreed with my view and sent me to the state of Qi to discuss an alliance with the King of Qi.

sentences.simplified: 一切都很顺利，楚国与齐国结盟了。
sentences.traditional: 一切都很順利，楚國與齊國結盟了。
sentences.pinyin: yí qiè dōu hěn shùn lì chǔ guó yǔ qí guó jié méng le
sentences.english: Everything went smoothly, and the state of Chu allied with the state of Qi.

sentence_translations: Chapter 4: My State of Chu
I have already introduced six of the seven major states in the late Warring States period.
Now I will introduce the last one—the state of Chu.
The southern state of Chu, my homeland, was the largest of the Seven Warring States in territory.
The relationship between the state of Chu and the state of Qin was quite complex.
Sometimes they were friendly, and sometimes they went to war over territory.
The state of Chu had a very important piece of land called Shangwu, covering more than six hundred li.
It had been seized by Qin during a war, and both the king and the people of Chu wanted to win it back.
This was the situation at the time.
The rulers of the Seven Warring States all understood this:
Only by becoming strong themselves could they avoid being conquered, and once they became strong, they could conquer others.
To protect themselves and conquer others, the Seven Warring States would form alliances.
For example, to avoid being conquered by Qin to the west, the four small states would seek an alliance with Qi to the east.
When five states combined, Qin would not dare to attack any one of them lightly.
Similarly, Chu would ally with Qi to attack Qin, and Qi would ally with Qin to attack Chu.
It seems a bit complicated, but that’s okay. You only need to know one thing:
The relationships between the Seven Warring States were constantly changing.
Today, they might be friends, but tomorrow, they could be enemies.
All right, having introduced the “Seven Warring States”, I will continue with the story.
Not long after I arrived at the Orchid Terrace, King Huai of Chu gave me a job.
This job was relatively easy—editing poetry and teaching cultural knowledge to the children of the royal family—and I did it well.
As our interactions increased, King Huai of Chu’s trust in me also deepened.
He and I shared the same ideals and had similar views on governing the state.
First, we both believed that the state of Chu needed a major reform.
The nobility had too much power, the army was poorly managed, the people’s lives were too hard, ..
.. and talented but poor people had no opportunity to become officials … these were all issues that the state of Chu needed to address.
Only by solving these problems could the state of Chu become strong.
Secondly, regarding relations with Qin, many officials and nobles of Chu, especially King Huai of Chu’s youngest son Zilan, ..
.. believed that Chu should ally with Qin and maintain a friendly relationship.
However, I believed that Qin would not truly maintain a friendly relationship with Chu. Instead, Chu should ally with Qi.
King Huai of Chu agreed with my view and sent me to the state of Qi to discuss an alliance with the King of Qi.
Everything went smoothly, and the state of Chu allied with the state of Qi.
